It positions itself as a solutions partner rather than a component supplier, bringing design, prototyping and production together under one roof and building customised parts to customer specification. currentContext.strengths: Six decades of accumulated expertise in magnets and magnetic assemblies; described as the preferred, and often the only, supplier across its product categories|Multidisciplinary knowledge base spanning metallurgy, mechanical, electrical and electronics engineering, allowing design-to-production solutions under one roof|In-house design, simulation and customer-specific prototyping capability that lets it optimise client designs rather than only build to print|Proprietary process technologies including NADCAP-compliant annealing furnaces, cited as a source of favourable cost structures|Advanced measurement and qualification infrastructure (Koerzimat, BH Loop Plotter, AEC-Q200 lab) supporting stringent customer quality benchmarks and regular customer audits|Broad capability-led portfolio of 350+ actively manufactured SKUs across eight end-industries, reducing dependence on any single technology cycle|AS9100D certification at the alloys facility opening aerospace and defence opportunities|Licensing agreement with REL Developments Limited, UK for Latching Relays, a product worth up to five times the value of its existing shunt and CT basket
currentContext.strategies: Scale up commercial operations across three named growth pillars: Alloys, Relays and Quantum Magnetics, converting existing groundwork into commercial results|Build versatile core capabilities and technologies rather than individual products, so the portfolio stays resilient through technological shifts and addresses a broad market|Grow the Alloys division into a major vertical by scaling commercial production through FY27 and engaging customers in oil and gas, aerospace and other sectors, leveraging AS9100D certification for aerospace and defence entry|Move the metering business up-value into Latching Relays, manufactured under a licensing agreement with REL Developments Limited, UK, a product worth up to five times the value of the existing shunt and CT basket|Localise a neodymium rare earth permanent magnet value chain in India through subsidiary Quantum Magnetics under a joint venture agreement|Widen the automotive and EV customer base and target a broader range of automotive and industrial products, already supplying electric two-wheeler OEMs, to offset Chinese share gains at Western EV manufacturers|Consolidate manufacturing operations into a single, more efficient facility over time on land already acquired
currentContext.expansion: PML's expansion in FY26 centred on three growth projects. In the Alloys division a new furnace was installed in January and commercialised in Q4FY26, running close to optimum capacity for the remainder of the year; the division entered FY27 with better order visibility and growing enquiries from oil & gas, aerospace and industrial customers, supported by AS 9100D:2016 certification. The Relay manufacturing facility, for Latching Relays to be made under a licensing agreement with REL Developments Limited, UK, is largely ready and progressing through testing and customer qualification, with commercial production now expected to commence in H2FY27 (behind the original timeline because customers require extended endurance testing before adopting a new supplier); the facility has been designed with scalable capacity to support future growth in smart metering. Subsidiary Quantum Magnetics, operating under a joint venture agreement to localise a neodymium magnet value chain in India, is advancing Phase 2 implementation covering block cutting, machining and surface treatment, with that next phase of investment expected in Q3FY27 and a long-term ambition of integrated capacity of 5,000 tonnes by FY31. Separately, the Company has acquired land to bring its manufacturing operations together into a single, more efficient facility over time, and states that for FY27 it plans to continue investing in capacity expansion and to pursue incremental growth opportunities.
